children.name: Spring time March and May , fall season September to November has good weather . December to February is winter and cold outside in morning and evening time but nice and sunny during day time. July and august is rainy season so expect rain but weather is unpredictable like other places in the world. if you go higher altitude is cooler and lower altitude is warmer in Bhutan. due to mountains can enjoy nice breeze too. most of the days are clear except monsoon and good for hiking.
